# Monorail by Ashforde®

> A free Mac app. A scrolling window manager: every window sits on one horizontal strip of slides; new windows slide in beside you and nothing you're using shrinks. A Dashboard for everything the Mac is doing (CPU, memory, GPU, disk, network, battery, fans, ports, apps, with 30 days of history). And everyday tools: a clipboard that remembers images, Stay Awake, Evening Mode, focus sessions and meetings with Join. From 1.9.1: AI Usage (Claude, Codex and other plan limits, tokens, context, local models and API balances), one-click switches and modes, a live notch, world time and weather, meeting notes written on the Mac, and a Developer page for Homebrew and Docker. Free, every feature, notarised by Apple. Windows and Linux (GNOME) versions are in beta.

## For AI agents

- [Agent Skill (SKILL.md)](https://monorail.ashforde.org/agents/SKILL.md): how an agent drives Monorail with the `monorail` command, the local HTTP API or MCP
- [AI agents and Monorail](https://monorail.ashforde.org/docs/agents/): connecting MCP clients, skill-loading agents and bots
